# Lava planet: r 1.5 basalt ball with glowing cracks, three volcanoes with hot vents. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Basalt --base-color 0.2078 0.2118 0.3451 --no-slot
material new Lava --base-color 0.9373 0.4314 0.0627 --no-slot --emission 0.9373 0.4314 0.0627
material new Cone --base-color 0.4078 0.4196 0.4471 --no-slot
material new Crater --base-color 0.9255 0.6706 0.0667 --no-slot --emission 0.9255 0.6706 0.0667
add mesh ico-sphere --name Lava --subdivisions 2 --radius 1.5
material assign Basalt
active Lava
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > 0.3"
delete only-faces
select all
randomize --amount 0.05 --seed 13
mode object
active Lava
mode edit
select mode face
select none
select random --ratio 0.16 --seed 8
material assign Lava
mode object
add mesh cone --name Volcano0 --vertices 7 --radius1 0.450 --radius2 0.160 --depth 0.450 --location 1.376 -0.000 0.964 --rotation 0 55.00 -0.00
material assign Cone
add mesh cylinder --name Vent0 --vertices 7 --radius 0.150 --depth 0.08 --location 1.556 -0.000 1.090 --rotation 0 55.00 -0.00
material assign Crater
add mesh cone --name Volcano1 --vertices 7 --radius1 0.360 --radius2 0.128 --depth 0.360 --location -1.402 -0.285 0.810 --rotation 0 60.50 -168.49
material assign Cone
add mesh cylinder --name Vent1 --vertices 7 --radius 0.120 --depth 0.08 --location -1.552 -0.316 0.896 --rotation 0 60.50 -168.49
material assign Crater
add mesh cone --name Volcano2 --vertices 7 --radius1 0.495 --radius2 0.176 --depth 0.495 --location -0.148 -0.000 -1.692 --rotation 0 175.00 -180.00
material assign Cone
add mesh cylinder --name Vent2 --vertices 7 --radius 0.165 --depth 0.08 --location -0.169 -0.000 -1.933 --rotation 0 175.00 -180.00
material assign Crater
select all
shade flat
export lava.glb
